source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Numbers 31–36 align directly with all 228 corresponding Hebrew records. Each original XML record is hashed in full. Earlier Numbers numbering differences and the two-record binding at public 26:1 remain preserved in earlier ledgers.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the kinship-based challenge and its accusation of unequal burdens.
Retains the harsh brood accusation and collective consequences rather than neutralizing the rhetoric.
Preserves Moses’ attribution of prospective destruction to the tribes’ withdrawal.
Renders being clear or guiltless as discharge of the stated obligation without erasing its divine and communal dimensions.
Retains the alternative western allotment rather than inventing total disinheritance.
Preserves the renaming notice without supplying unknown replacement names.
Renders Machir’s family as the collective actor across the Hebrew shift to singular dispossession.
Keeps the named ancestor while making the collective settlement reference understandable.
